# xyOps Provider

Terraform provider for xyOps, a server scheduler and monitor. Set endpoint and api_key in the configuration, or provide XYOPS_ENDPOINT and XYOPS_API_KEY. xyops_server adopts a server that already registered itself and does not create or delete it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    xyops = {
      source = "santos-edu/xyops"
    }
  }
}

provider "xyops" {
  # endpoint is required: set it here or provide XYOPS_ENDPOINT.
  endpoint = "https://xyops.example.com"
  # api_key is read from XYOPS_API_KEY by default.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) xyOps API key. Set this value or provide XYOPS_API_KEY.
- `endpoint` (String) xyOps API base URL. Required: set this value or provide XYOPS_ENDPOINT.
